summary: The LDAP injection flow takes the `id` value from the servlet query string and concatenates it directly into an LDAP search filter `(cn=<data>)`, letting an attacker inject filter metacharacters. I fixed it by escaping the LDAP special characters (`\`, `*`, `(`, `)`, NUL) per RFC 4515 before building the filter, so legitimate lookups still work but injected filter syntax is neutralized. The feature (searching by the supplied id) is preserved.
